description:
You see something on the street and wonder what it's called. Looking it up means a dictionary, then the pronunciation, then an example sentence, then making a flashcard. So you don't. Or you do, and it's gone by the next time you see it.
CatchWords turns that moment into a word you keep. Photograph the thing: you get the word people in Taiwan actually use, its reading, a natural voice and example sentences, and a sticker cut out of your own photo goes into your collection.

■ Snap it, and the word appears
・Take a photo and you get word suggestions for each thing in it
・Not among them? Look it up with "Type a different word"

■ Your photo becomes your own flashcard
・Each word has zhuyin or pinyin, the meaning, a natural Taiwanese Mandarin voice, example sentences and common phrases. Sentences can be played too
・Example sentences use the vocabulary and grammar of the TOCFL level you set
・The date and place are saved, and you can add a one-line note later
・Selfie mode puts you, or you and your friends, in the picture with the word
・Snap the same thing again and the word collects more photos

■ A collection you want to fill
・Words line up in a collection by category. Words you haven't caught yet show as silhouettes, so you always know what to learn next

■ Reviews show the things you photographed
・Spaced repetition brings each word back as a 4-choice question just before you forget it, with your own photo as the cue
・Every word's memory state is shown in color and as a curve, so you can see which ones keep slipping
・Reminders at review time, or when you pass near a place where you caught a word, nudge you to review
・A Home Screen widget shows today's word

■ Made for
・People who want the words for the things they see every day
・People who find existing vocabulary books and language apps not enough

■ Your data
・Photos are analyzed and word explanations written by external AI services. The app shows what is sent and asks for your consent first. Without consent you can still browse and review the words you have
・You can delete your account at any time in Settings

Interface: English, Japanese
Language you learn: Taiwanese Mandarin (Traditional Chinese)

Privacy Policy: https://catchwords.lovable.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://catchwords.lovable.app/terms
promotionalText: See something and wonder what it's called? Snap it. You get the word people in Taiwan really use, your photo becomes the flashcard, and it comes back before you forget.
